summary: BookWyrm: a federated ActivityPub social reading and book-reviewing platform (Django + Postgres). Users follow each other, shelve/rate/review books, post statuses/comments/quotations, join groups, create curated lists and reading goals, import/export reading history, and moderators resolve reports and configure the instance.
